test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Stones were thrown at the dog.

options.text: They throw stones at the dog.
They threw stones at the dog.
They were throwing stones at the dog.
They had been throwing stones at the dog.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In passive voice, the sentence is: *"Stones were thrown at the dog."*
 
• To convert to active voice, introduce the implied subject **'They'**.
 
• Change the verb form: **"were thrown"** (past passive) → **"threw"** (past active).
 
• Thus, the correct active sentence is: **"They threw stones at the dog."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They threw stones at the dog."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"They throw stones at the dog." – Incorrect tense (present instead of past).
 
• **Option 3: **"They were throwing stones at the dog." – Incorrect continuous tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"They had been throwing stones at the dog." – Incorrect use of past perfect continuous tense.
